title: Racket Stringing Service Overdue Aging by Status
dataSources: SwingVision sessions (`swingvision:session`), UTR rating history (`utr:rating`), racket-sport sessions (`racket:session`), stringing and maintenance events (`stringing:service`).
app: SwingVision match video analytics, UTR rating snapshots, court-session logs, and racket stringing reminders streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=stringing:service
| eval days_overdue=round((now()-next_restring_epoch)/86400,1)
| where days_overdue>0
| stats avg(days_overdue) as avg_days_overdue max(days_overdue) as max_days_overdue count as items by service_status
| sort - avg_days_overdue
description: Measures how long overdue racket stringing service work is staying stuck in each status.
value: Aging by status shows whether the bottleneck is waiting on you, a vendor, a family member, or missing paperwork.
implementation: Review this weekly and tighten the workflow stage that owns the oldest overdue records.
visualization: Bar chart of average overdue days by status.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers where overdue stringing jobs are getting stuck instead of moving to done.
